title: Cumulative majority Fourier weight comparison
statement:
Let $m\in\mathbb N$. For every $j\in\mathbb N$ with $j\leq2(m+1)+2$, the cumulative Fourier weight through levels below $j$ of majority on $\{0,1\}^{2(m+1)+1}$ is at most that of majority on $\{0,1\}^{2m+1}$:
\[\sum_{k=0}^{j-1}W_k[M_{m+1}]\leq\sum_{k=0}^{j-1}W_k[M_m],\]
where $W_k[f]$ is the sum of squared Fourier--Walsh coefficients over subsets of size $k$.
replaced:
For each $q\in\mathbb N$, define $M_q:\{\pm1\}^{2q+1}\to\mathbb R$ to equal $1$ when
more than $q$ coordinates equal $1$, and $-1$ otherwise; for
$S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,2q+1\}$ define
$\widehat M_q(S)=2^{-(2q+1)}\sum_{x\in\{\pm1\}^{2q+1}}M_q(x)\prod_{i\in S}x_i$, and for
$k\in\mathbb N$ define $W_k(M_q)=\sum_{|S|=k}\widehat M_q(S)^2$.
For every $m,j\in\mathbb N$ satisfying $j\le2(m+1)+2$,
\[
 \sum_{k=0}^{j-1}W_k(M_{m+1})\le\sum_{k=0}^{j-1}W_k(M_m),
\]
where both sums are zero when $j=0$.
